OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

emergencyWithdraw(address,uint256).details: Owner can only withdraw the amount exceeding totalPrincipal (user staked + pending unstake principal).     The `owner` is held by a multisig / Timelock contract in production , guarantee not to do evil.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

RATE_BASE.details: Weight baseline (in bps). A stake's weight = amount * fixedRates[day] / RATE_BASE.      It is also the per-year rate the global node acc advances at under FixedRate mode.      With RATE_BASE = 6000 (60%): 180d(6000)=1x, 360d(9000)=1.5x, 90d(3000)=0.5x.      Any new tier is supported by simply configuring fixedRates[day]; a tier rate      lower than RATE_BASE (e.g. 90d => 30%) yields weight below principal, which is fine.

TEAM_SHARE.details: Virtual team stake used to reuse accPerShare math; this is not a real deposited amount.

remainders.details: The unallocated remainder from the previous division in each pool (multiplied by the scale) is carried over to the next accumulation to avoid precision loss during high-frequency updates.

teamNextClaimTime.details: the subsequent upgrade may not be zero.

totalPrincipal.details: Total user principal held by this contract (node + llm staked + pending unstake principal). Protected from emergencyWithdraw.

commissionRate().notice: cooling period for node owner, delegator, llm user to claim.

emergencyWithdraw(address,uint256).notice: Emergency withdraw surplus DGAI (reward pool funds), user principal is protected.

fixedRates(uint64).notice: lock tier => rate in bps. 180 => 6000 (60%), 360 => 9000 (90%).         Add any tier freely, including below RATE_BASE (e.g. 90 => 3000 / 30%).

lastTimeClaimNodeOwner(address).notice: pending claim for node owner, delegator, llm user.

nodeWeightCache(uint64).notice: Cached total delegated weight of a node (sum over all delegators/tiers).         Used as the FixedRate-mode commission divisor; maintained incrementally.

positions(uint64,address,uint64).notice: Per-tier stake of a user under a node. Supports multiple tiers at once.

stake(uint64,uint64,uint256).notice: delegater choose a node to stake.

treasury().notice: The user's activity is recorded by the backend after the tdgai swap; the interaction with the hanldePreStake function transfers the information from the treasury to this contract.

userDayExists(uint64,address,uint64).notice: Whether a lock tier is currently indexed in `userDays`.

userDays(uint64,address,uint256).notice: Lock tiers a user currently holds under a node (index for `positions`).

userPendingUnstakeIds(uint64,address,uin.notice: Pending unstake request ids indexed by node/user/day for reward preview and claim.

userPreStaked(address).notice: whether a user has pre staked
